## Daata processing

```{r load data and combine the needed information to one data frame}
clinical <- read.csv("data/tcga_brca_clinical.csv")
names(clinical)[names(clinical)=="stage"] <- "stg"

sum(is.na(clinical$stg)) #count NA stage

clinical$stage[clinical$stg %in% c("stage ia", "stage ib", "stage i")] <- "Stage I"
clinical$stage[clinical$stg %in% c("stage iia", "stage iib", "stage ii")] <- "Stage II"
clinical$stage[clinical$stg %in% c("stage iiia", "stage iiib", "stage iiic")] <- "Stage III"
clinical$stage[clinical$stg =="stage iv"] <- "Stage IV"
# Stage X refers to cases that are undetermined -- missing ones treat as NA

sum(is.na(clinical$stage))
table(clinical$stage)

expression <- read.csv("data/tcga_brca_expression.csv")
genes <- names(expression)[names(expression) != "patient_id"]
methylation <- read.csv("data/tcga_brca_methylation.csv")
met_sites <- names(methylation)[names(methylation) != "patient_id"]
df_exp <- na.omit(merge(clinical[,c("patient_id", "stage")], expression, by="patient_id"))
df_met <- na.omit(merge(clinical[,c("patient_id", "stage")], methylation, by="patient_id"))

combined <- merge(expression, methylation, by="patient_id")
```
```{r data summary}
summary(df_exp)
summary(df_met)
```
```{r pca helper function}
pca_biplot <- function(pca, ref, show_loadings=FALSE){

  plot_data <- data.frame(
    stage=factor(
      clinical$stage[match(ref$patient_id, clinical$patient_id)]
    )
  )
  
  p <- autoplot(
    pca, 
    data=plot_data, 
    colour="stage", 
    scale = 0
  ) +
    labs(
      title = "prcomp() biplot with autoplot()",
      subtitle = "Points are patients; arrows show variable directions"
    ) 
  
  if (show_loadings) {
    arrows <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, c("PC1", "PC2"), drop = FALSE])
    arrows$feature <- rownames(arrows)

    # Apply the same multiplier to both axes to preserve arrow directions.
    multiplier <- 0.8 * max(abs(pca$x[, c("PC1", "PC2")])) /
      max(abs(as.matrix(arrows[, c("PC1", "PC2")])))
    arrows$PC1 <- arrows$PC1 * multiplier
    arrows$PC2 <- arrows$PC2 * multiplier
    
    arrows$type <- ifelse(arrows$feature %in% genes, "expression", "methylation")

    p <- p +
      ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
      geom_segment(
        data = arrows,
        aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2, colour = type),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(2, "mm"))
      ) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = arrows,
        aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = feature, colour = type),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        show.legend = FALSE,
        size = 2.5
      ) +
      labs(colour = "Feature type")
    
  }
  p + theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}

pca_screeplot <- function(pca, ref, center=TRUE){
  
  pc_names <- colnames(pca$rotation)
  variance <- pca$sdev^2
  
  plot_variance <- data.frame(
    PC = factor(pc_names, levels = pc_names),
    VE = 100 * variance / sum(variance)
  )
  
  ggplot(plot_variance, aes(PC, VE)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#16847f", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", VE)), vjust = -0.4, size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(plot_variance$VE) * 1.15),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance explained by each principal component",
    x = "Principal component",
    y = "Proportion of variance explained (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}

cor_plot <- function(X, Y=NULL) {
  
  cor_mtx <- cor(X, y=Y)
  
  tiles <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mtx))
  names(tiles) <- c("row_feature", "col_feature", "r")
  
  ggplot(tiles, aes(x = col_feature, y = row_feature, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1),
      na.value = "grey80", name = "Pearson r"
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(tiles$row_feature))) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

```{r pca on expression data}
X_exp <- as.matrix(expression[,names(expression)!="patient_id"])

cor_plot(X_exp)

pca_exp <- prcomp(X_exp, center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE)

pca_biplot(pca_exp, ref=expression, show_loadings=TRUE)
pca_screeplot(pca_exp, ref=expression)
```
```{r pca for met}
X_met <- as.matrix(methylation[,names(methylation)!="patient_id"])

cor_plot(X_met)

pca_met <- prcomp(X_met,center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE)

pca_biplot(pca_met, ref=methylation, show_loadings=TRUE)
pca_screeplot(pca_met, ref=methylation)

```
```{r pca for combined data}
X_comb <- as.matrix(combined[,names(combined)!="patient_id"])
pca_comb <- prcomp(X_comb, center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)

pca_biplot(pca_comb, ref=combined, show_loadings=TRUE)
pca_screeplot(pca_comb, ref=combined)
```
